title: A status change refused after the save keeps the confirmation open
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • A second browser tab is open on the same site, signed in as the same Admin at {Location-A}.
  • Active part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REFUSED-01), with Sell Price $20.00, is stocked at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. In tab 1, type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  2. In tab 1, click the {Part-A} row.
  3. In tab 1, change the Sell Price to 25.00.
  4. In tab 1, click the Inactive option.
  5. In tab 2, type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  6. In tab 2, click the {Part-A} row.
  7. In tab 2, click the Inactive option.
  8. In tab 2, click Save.
  9. In tab 2, click Deactivate.
  10. In tab 1, click Save.
  11. In tab 1, click Deactivate.
  12. In tab 1, wait 10 seconds. Do not close anything.
  13. In tab 1, close the red message.
  14. In tab 1, click Cancel in the confirmation.
  15. In tab 1, click Cancel on the part window.
  16. In tab 1, click the Inactive tab.
  17. In tab 1, type {Part-A} in the search.
  18. In tab 1, click the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 9: in tab 2 the part is deactivated and "Part deactivated." shows.
  • Step 11: in tab 1 the confirmation stays open. A red message reads "This part could not be deactivated" with the reason "Part is already in that state."
  • Step 12: the red message is still showing: it stays until it is closed.
  • Step 18: the title row pill reads "Inactive" and the Sell Price reads $25.00: the form was saved before the status change was refused.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-N4, S13-R22, S10-R13a, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.3 (Save asks first), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-N4: “If the status change is refused after the save, the confirmation stays open and the system shows "This part could not be deactivated" or "This part could not be activated", with the reason.”
  • S13-R22: “Confirming saves every change in the dialog, then applies the status, and closes the dialog with "Part deactivated." or "Part activated.".”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part deactivated from the part dialog): “"Part deactivated." | Success toast, fades on its own”
  • S10-R13a: “The reasons are "A core follows its part. Activate or deactivate the part instead.", "Part not found." and "Part is already in that state."”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Status change from the part dialog refused): “"This part could not be deactivated" / "This part could not be activated", with the reason | Error toast, stays until closed”
